user.title: Connect to IFB Washing Machine
user.description: Enter the local network IP address of your IFB washing machine. Ensure the appliance is powered on and connected to your home Wi-Fi.

data_description.host: Local static IP or DHCP reserved address of the washing machine on your home Wi-Fi network (e.g. 192.168.0.100).
data_description.port: Local HTTP port used by the GainSpan module (default: 80).

model.title: Select Model
model.description: Select your {type_name} model series from the list, or choose Custom Model:

data_description.model: Specific model line (e.g. WD Executive ZXS, TurboDry, Senator, or custom).

custom_model_text.title: Custom Model Name
custom_model_text.description: Enter your exact IFB appliance model name as printed on the fascia panel or rating label:

verify_initial.title: Step 1: Confirm Current Program
verify_initial.description:
Your machine is currently reporting **{active_name}** (Code {active_code}).

Does your machine's screen or indicator show **{active_name}**?

verify_phase1.title: Step 2: Same-Side Test
verify_phase1.description:
Home Assistant sent a test command to select **{target_name}** (Code {target_code}) from the same program group.

Does your machine's screen or indicator show **{target_name}**?

verify_phase2.title: Step 3: Opposite-Side Test
verify_phase2.description:
Home Assistant sent a test command to select **{target_name}** (Code {target_code}) from the opposite program group.

Does your machine's screen or indicator show **{target_name}**?

custom.title: Custom Configuration
custom.description: Your IFB washing machine will be configured in manual mode.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the washing machine. Please verify the IP address and ensure the machine is powered on.
error.invalid_response: Received an unexpected response format from the appliance.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred during connection test.

abort.already_configured: This IFB washing machine is already configured in Home Assistant.

init.title: IFB Washer Local Options
init.description: Adjust operational scan intervals and model information:

data_description.model: Display model name shown in Home Assistant device registry.
data_description.scan_interval_standby: Polling interval in seconds while the washer is idle or in standby (default: 15s).
data_description.scan_interval_running: Polling interval in seconds while an active wash cycle is running (default: 5s).
